responsibility: This installed helper header provides the private AArch64 FP8 support types and macros shared by the public NEON, SVE, and SME headers. It defines the scalar `mfloat8_t` and `fpm_t` types, enumerations describing FP8 source/destination formats and overflow behavior, and bitfield-manipulation macros for constructing floating-point mode control values, so the public ACLE headers can expose FP8 intrinsics and control operands consistently without duplicating these low-level definitions.
